simple.summary: נָפָה (nâphâh) means a sieve First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 4 11.

definitions.full: H5299. naphah I. [ נָפָה ] noun feminine sieve or other winnowing implement, Di Du Schwinge , Che Hpt fan (as swung ); — only construct שָׁוְא בְּנָ֫פַת גוֺיִם לַהֲנָפָה Isa 30:28 to swing nations in a sieve of worthlessness. II. [ נָפָה ] noun feminine height ; — only construct in combination דּוֺר נָפַת Josh 12:23 = ׳נ דּאֹר 1Kin 4:11 , plural construct ד ׳נָפוֺת Josh 11:2 ; compare II. דּוֺד , and Di 11:2 ; see also [ נֶפֶת ].
